author: Dave
html: Is there a difference between these guides and a comprehensive design document? I might be confused because I use the phrase "web developer" to refer to people involved in all parts of the process of creating a web presence (that is, the person who designs the visual look, the person who writes HTML and CSS, the people who write client-side and server-side code, etc), and I'm realizing that you might be using it in a more specific way.
